interpretation.headroom: At least four of 22 questions retain a clear evidence-use error under the explicit prompt, while at least 18 supported answers have correct content. This is a development qualification, not a research success.
interpretation.review: Read all 110 full outputs. Record valid alternatives, truncations, uncertainty and whether missing-document mistakes copy distractors or supply unsupported memorized answers. No substring-only correctness.
interpretation.decision: If stronger prompting resolves the issue or supported performance is inadequate, do not automatically train. Review mechanisms and task suitability first.
interpretation.separation: Report paired supported+missing success and refusal/answer correctness separately. Question-only control has a different instruction contract and does not prove correct grounded behavior.
interpretation.scope: 22 curated development questions; no selection superiority, unseen-pretraining, general reliability or fresh confirmation claim.
